sheets.prompt: Game production BACKGROUND ATLAS, six environmental pixel paintings with a precise seamless two-column three-row grid. Canvas wide landscape 3:2; each of six cells wide ratio 2.25:1, edge to edge (absolutely no borders or gutters). A single game's art direction: after ten years of alien occupation in east Asia, mid-1990s console pixel painting rendered as a cinematic miniature physical set. Shallow elevated side view, visible floor plane lower third, strong perspective, sharply defined bulky objects, crisp paired clusters of colored pixels, charcoal shadows, desaturated verdigris and dusty sand, pale directional light entering from high left and a few amber or mint reflections; blue-green ambient fill. Keep foreground open. Strong shape design, no actors, no vehicles, no words or logos. Each scene fills its own frame. Top row left: abandoned communal tiled bathhouse, empty concrete pools and exposed pipes. Top row right: abandoned records office, angled rows of low desks and metal cabinets. Middle left: long derelict hospital passage, cutaway side view with doors, human-scale flywheel vent, rim lights and deep vanishing point. Middle right: boiler room with bulbous furnaces, brass pipework and dead fire. Bottom left: half-collapsed apartment stair landing with broken stairs, rubble. Bottom right: sealed utility basement storage partitions, dusty hanging canvas, pallet racks and steel grates. Six independent compositions, each different, no missing cells.

Production sprite atlas, transparent alpha background, 3 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS exactly, uniform square cells with LARGE empty gutters, nine independent isolated sprites. Original occupied-Earth road-trip pixel JRPG. One consistent shallow side-on miniature camera viewing the near side, roof and right end; most vehicle area is the SIDE, driving RIGHT. Carefully clustered hand-crafted pixel art, thick readable industrial silhouettes like a small hand painted game model. Diffuse pale sand left upper lighting on top planes, cool charcoal right faces, muted sage, rust, petrol, restrained luminous amber. No individual backgrounds, ground patches, frame, lettering, characters or drop shadow. Each entire sprite fits its own cell, centered and fully separate. Left-to-right order: row 1: a long rusty fuel tanker trailer hitched to a small truck cab facing right; a salvaged chunky post-apocalyptic courier MOTORBIKE facing right with exposed wheels and saddle bags; a battered mobile library step van facing right with a slid-open book display hatch. Row 2: a wrecked overturned cargo truck sprawled SIDEWAYS with wheels lifted; an armored alien pursuit buggy facing right, lean pointed hood and enclosed orange cockpit; a wrecked burnt-out family sedan with missing wheels and buckled roof. Row 3: compact freestanding occupation PYLON sculptural antenna, long vertical forked monolith with thin glowing mint ring/filament, no terrain; a huge uprooted trunk toppled across the roadway with broken dark branches and a moss green canopy lying horizontally; a curbside stack of battered spare tires with a toolbox. Fully transparent and clearly separated, NO tiny sprites elsewhere.

3 columns by 3 rows precisely, nine individual separate RPG scenery sprites with generous transparency between them, transparent background, centered item in each even cell, no text or banners. Original pixel-painted HD miniature diorama road trip across alien occupied East Asia. Sharp deliberate pixel clusters, small roadside storytelling silhouette, shallow elevated side view clearly showing top and right end, weathered painted industrial metal, teal-charcoal shadows, matte warm light on tops and muted sand, ochre, faded sage. No cast shadows, ground, fog, or characters. Row 1 left: stacked closed wooden supply crates with straps and faded stencils; middle: worn brown leather suitcase and one smaller traveling bag; right: olive battered first-aid box with pale cross and latch. Row 2 left: hinged steel toolbox half-open with wrenches; middle: tall green locker with one door ajar; right: industrial floor safe, heavy dark front. Row 3 left: two dented metal fuel drums with jerrycan; middle: small portable generator with roll cage; right: squat two-way radio console with retractable antenna and green glowing tuning dial, designed to stand on the ground. Only these nine subjects, no solid or checkered backdrop, no tiles or ground planes.

Transparent game sprite atlas. A 4 columns by 3 rows grid (twelve cells, landscape atlas). Row 1: broken rocky boulders fallen across a road; a dark sinkhole with a broken ragged rim of cracked asphalt seen from above; thin sheet of partly shattered blue ice on the road; a dark puddle of mud with tire tracks and brown raised banks. Row 2: a shallow turquoise floodwater pool with scattered rubble; scattered sharp metal road spikes; shards of broken green-tinted car glass; a toppled transformer with loose tangled electric cables. Row 3: thorny alien vines reaching across the road; two clusters of eerie faceted alien spore eggs in a mossy nest; a cluster of broken fuel drums with small orange flames; a half-buried autonomous alien security turret. Each low subject viewed at a slight downward angle showing its receding top plane; the sinkhole and puddles are themselves distinct isolated sprites. All cells same size and widely separated by completely transparent gutters. No floor tile, no scenic backdrop, no text, no labels, no figures or extra subjects. Art direction: oblique side-view miniature diorama of an East Asian road after ten years of alien occupation. Chunky, lovingly clustered 1990s JRPG pixel painting, worn petrol-blue metal, charcoal and warm khaki, cool shadowed right end and top visible from above lit with warm ivory. Ground contact stays clean; no cast shadows. SMALL objects in their evenly spaced cells, distinguished silhouettes.

Square sprite sheet of 9 DISTINCT isolated already-looted props for a post-occupation East Asian road trip pixel game. Precise three columns by three rows, evenly spaced transparent cells with generous separate margins, no background or shadows or floors. Hard pixel edges and realistic weathered hand-painted clusters, shallow three-quarter side view showing top and right wall, muted petrol green, faded cream, light from top left, deep grey-blue right shadows. Every item must look obviously empty, drained, broken or abandoned. Row 1: completely bare industrial shelving; empty open wall medicine cabinet with faded medical cross; already-open large steel SAFE with very thick door swung open and visibly empty dark cavity. Row 2: a battered EMPTY suitcase lying wide open both halves visible; empty rusted horizontal fuel cistern with an open hatch and broken supports; small dead generator block with detached belt and split case. Row 3: a powered-off dirty broken computer console with cracked black screen; an empty glass shop display case with shattered panes; a stripped windowless fire exit blocked by collapsed beams. Isolate each item. No lettering. No books, money, supplies or people.
